reason: r65 approved for distribution by the user on 2026-11-02 and promoted unchanged from its candidate. r65 renames the mod from Modern Sharpness Gauge at the player's request: "rename mod from modern-sharpness-gauge to world-sharpness-gauge, because modern mh has very long gauge that have sharpness bar that use all sharpness, not per tier, like our current mod. this mod is more close to mh world". The crate, NRO, package, plugin label, log prefix (WSG) and symbols change with it. It also consolidates r64, whose per-tier fill the player accepted on Eden. The fill, the cut, the shade, the colour code and the tree (6 nodes, 7-word map, 13 records) are unchanged. Removed: the cGUIObjRoot destructor hook, its log line and its signature window, because it fired in no saved log while the mask's link checks caught every row's end; the unused per-frame read of mSharpnessType; and core code only the tests used (scan_walk, Node, Walk, FIELDS, the sample's identity fields). Added: one `fill refused` log line per gauge row, so a stock bar during a hunt can be told from a failed insertion. 25 host fixtures pass; verify PASSED with 32 signature windows. r65 ran on Eden, log only; r64 stays the build whose picture the player accepted.
runtime_test: r65, Eden master-7a6d055094, 2026-11-02, log only, no player report of its picture: installed NRO aeb9d1be49f1dfbf66a1c755d82442e6b262f2c3e440e83f496f796abebd8791 is the r65 payload. WSG r65 lines: gauge row check stopped at stage 21 at 26.534176; scissor mask inserted at 200.371389, 792.621557 and 1613.561990, each with entries=7 records=13; inserted mask's links lost at 716.527334 (1 times), 1265.082368 (2 times) and 2640.511103 (3 times). No `fill refused`, insertion failure or 'shade blade not added' line and no guest exception. See EVIDENCE.json runtime_r65_eden_2026_11_02. The player's acceptance is on other bytes: r64 on Eden ("just done 2 quests with different weapon, with first quest death to fail, all works perfectly"), see EVIDENCE.json runtime_r64_eden_2026_11_02 and runtime_r64_eden_2026_11_02_second_session, and for the drawing of the cut and the shade accepted r62's Eden run of 2026-11-01 at the red tier (crop sha256 bb02addc7e2fe678977f453a08af0fcffdf7d6d68fc8e708dfc62329d16a1fdb). Sharpness+1/+2 and Heavy Polish were not exercised. Ryujinx and Switch hardware remain unconfirmed.

limitations: r65's Eden run is log evidence only, with no player report of its picture; its fill, cut, shade and tree code is r64's, and r64 is the accepted build
the fill is accepted by the player's eye on the bar, not by a recorded number: the build logs no fill value, so no run carries a band value
the raised-maximum band ends have no runtime check: no saved log was identified as using a Sharpness skill, so host fixtures and static reading are the evidence
Heavy Polish over the banded bar has no runtime check
the `fill refused` line has never been seen in a run; it may print at a normal quest end, and it means a failure only when the stock bar shows during a hunt
the fill makes about 18 native calls per frame on the draw thread; that thread is one thread by static reading and unconfirmed at runtime
the colour driver's order against adjustSharpness and the draw is unread, so a tier drop could show a full bar in the old colour briefly; the player reports nothing wrong
a gauge row lasting one quest is inference from row ends beside save commits and tester reports: no log line marks an area change
the clip mask's bit 17 is the transform gate in main+0xa4964c / main+0xa4969c; what the shade looks like once the clip is composed rests on accepted r62's red-tier crop

the game's destructor is assumed to free the map block the mod publishes through the cGUIInstance DTI's MT allocator; that free has not been observed, and the old 4-word block still leaks, 16 bytes per quest
the coloured part keeps the glow's halo (Txt_sharpefx at PosX 6, PosY -6, 88x32, alpha 120) and the dark part has none: a design question left open
the bar rect other than 110..238: the scaled cut offsets have only been seen where they reproduce the measured numbers
ARM fixtures for insertion and allocation failure are not written

evidence.static_summary: r65: pinned toolchain build; 25 host fixtures passed; verify.py PASSED with 32 NSO signature windows, a unique hook window, the exact export set, resolved imports only, no MSR in the disassembly, no DT_TEXTREL and a one-file payload. The fill is (current - floor) * 10000 / (ceiling - floor) inside the tier band, with ceiling clipped to mMaxSharpness; the band is found by binary search on uPlayerBase::calculateSharpnessType (main+0x29cdfc) behind three safety gates. The native facts are re-verified against the original bytes by work/world-sharpness-gauge/scripts/verify_tier_gauge.py. See EVIDENCE.json, DEVELOPMENT.md, work/world-sharpness-gauge/TIER_GAUGE_RESEARCH.md and work/world-sharpness-gauge/ROW_LIFETIME_AND_FIXED_TIER_RESEARCH.md.
evidence.manual_summary: r65 ran on Eden on 2026-11-02 with the installed NRO matching the payload: three rows inserted and three released in the log, no player report of its picture. r64, its source for the fill, was played on Eden in two sessions on 2026-11-02, the installed NRO matching the packaged payload both times, and accepted by eye: "from playing and look at the visuals it looks right", and "just done 2 quests with different weapon, with first quest death to fail, all works perfectly". The worn-blade drawing was accepted on r62 at the red tier on 2026-11-01. r61 was packaged, never run, withdrawn. Ryujinx and Switch hardware unconfirmed.
